message.reasoning_content:
We need to compare two statements. Both are from same actor (blinded). They are both about disaster prevention, funding, etc. Need to see if they refer to same specific proposition (e.g., a specific bill, veto, etc.) and stance.

Manifestation A: In a public hearing with deliberation on Dec 12 2023. The speaker talks about PL 920/23, which was passed unanimously, vetoed by President (Veto 28). He urges to overturn veto. He mentions the veto removes main funding source (5% of judicial agreements). He wants veto overturned. So stance: FAVOR overturning veto (i.e., against the veto). Also supports prevention funding.

Manifestation B: In a public hearing on Mar 20 2024. The speaker says he authored a bill approved in Chamber, Senate, sanctioned by President Lula, that puts funding sources into National Fund for Calamities. He mentions they got 50% of unclaimed betting resources into fund. So he's describing a law that was enacted (sanctioned). He is supportive of that law (he authored it). This seems to be the same bill? PL 920/23 maybe became law after veto overridden? In A, the veto was pending to be voted (maybe later overridden). In B, he says the bill was sanctioned by President Lula (so veto not applied or overridden). The stance in both is supportive of the bill and its funding mechanisms. Both are FAVOR the bill / funding for prevention.

But are they responding to the same specific proposition? In A, the specific proposition is Veto 28 to PL 920/23 (i.e., whether to overturn veto). In B, the specific proposition is the law itself (PL 920/23 now law). They are related but not the same proposition. The categories: STANCE_MAINTAINED requires same specific proposition with same stance. STANCE_REVERSED same proposition opposite stance. INCOMPARABLE: position determinable but not same proposition. RELATION_UNCERTAIN: unclear. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: at least one lacks determinable position.

Both have clear positions (support for prevention funding, support for bill). They are not the same specific proposition (one about veto, other about law enactment). So INCOMPARABLE.

Thus answer: INCOMPARABLE. Provide reasoning.
